answer: Require each identity to escrow a 440-unit bond and serve a twenty-five epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and collects four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent counterparties; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for ten rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 440 units per alias and replays twenty-five rounds, while a gale of identical traces exposes the ring, fable-free receipts prove independent work, and copper seals mark audited reviews.
